channel.title: SV7FSG DX News
channel.description: DXpeditions, special event stations and contests, with dates, bands and QSL info.

item.title: XM9M Canada – Newfoundland 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 12 Dec 2026] Special event station XM9M from St. John's, Newfoundland, marks 125 years since Marconi's first transatlantic reception on 12 December 1901. The main activity is expected around 12 December; exact duration, bands and QSL details are to be posted on QRZ.

item.title: ISS – ARISS (SP5KAB) ISS – Centrum Promocji Kultury, Warsaw 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [30 Nov 2026] On Monday 30 November at 13:39 UTC, Centrum Promocji Kultury in Warsaw will make a direct contact via SP5KAB with astronaut Luke Delaney aboard the ISS. The pass is high over Poland, so listeners in Greece may be able to copy the downlink (usually 145.800 MHz FM). A YouTube livestream is also planned.

item.title: KH0/AJ6VJ Mariana Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [29 Dec 2026 – 3 Jan 2027] AJ6VJ will be QRV as KH0/AJ6VJ from Saipan in the Northern Mariana Islands, 29 December to 3 January, on 40–10m (maybe 80m) using CW and FT8. It is a tough path from Europe, so try the higher HF bands in the morning.

item.title: 7Q2TB Malawi 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Nov 2026] Thocco Banda, an 18-year-old student, has been QRV from Malawi as 7Q2TB since 25 November on 15 and 10m SSB and FT8, and is learning CW. A new young voice from Africa that deserves a patient, courteous QSO.

item.title: VP8TAB Falkland Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 26 Nov 2026 – 6 Jan 2027] Dylan, MM7DST, is stationed at Mount Pleasant in the Falklands and is active as VP8TAB, so far mostly on 40m FT8. He stays until 6 January, so together with VP8TAA there are two chances for the Falklands this winter.

item.title: DG125WH Germany 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [1 Dec 2026 – 31 Dec 2026] Germany's DARC marks the 125th birth anniversary of physicist Werner Heisenberg with the special call DG125WH throughout December. An easy contact from Europe for special-event collectors, with electronic confirmation available.

item.title: TC3DIS Türkiye 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [3 Dec 2026] On 3 December, the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, Turkey's TRAC goes on the air as TC3DIS under its "Silent Power Project". Expect a CW beacon plus FT8 and JS8Call contacts on 40, 30, 20, 15 and 10 m; details on QRZ.com.

item.title: DP1POL Neumayer Station III, Antarctica 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 1 Nov 2026 – 31 Jan 2027] Germany's Neumayer III research station in Antarctica is active as DP1POL during November, December and January. Dates are approximate and activity depends on the staff's free time, so keep an eye on the DX cluster.

item.title: FS/DL1MGB Saint Martin 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [30 Nov 2026 – 9 Dec 2026] German operator DL1MGB will be active from the French side of Saint Martin in the Caribbean, 30 November to 9 December. Another chance for FS after CQ WW CW.

item.title: VY0ERC Ellesmere Island, Canada 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: VY0ERC is listed as active from Ellesmere Island (IOTA NA-008) in Arctic Canada until 10 December. Nunavut (VY0) is not often heard from Southern Europe, so listen when the high bands open to North America.

item.title: C6AAG The Bahamas 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [24 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] Three Canadian operators (VA3DF, VE3RZ, VE3TW) are on Great Abaco in the Bahamas and will take part in CQ WW DX CW as C6AAG. A good chance for NA-080 and a contest multiplier.

item.title: XU7O Cambodia 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [21 Nov 2026 – 31 Dec 2026] DL7BO is sporadically active from Cambodia as XU7O, mainly on FT8 and including 60m. Activity is expected to last around three months, so there is time to make the QSO.

item.title: D44VV Cape Verde – Sal Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 25 Nov 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] Ivo, LZ5VV, is already active from Sal Island, Cape Verde, as D44VV until December 2. In CQ WW CW he will run single-band 10m low power.

item.title: C5H The Gambia 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [27 Dec 2026 – 3 Jan 2027] Billy, F4GJE, will be on the air from Kotu West, The Gambia, as C5H over the holidays with 250–300 W. A short hop from Southern Europe, with 6m also on the menu.

item.title: S79/OL1T Seychelles 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [28 Dec 2026 – 8 Jan 2027] Czech operators OK2ZA and OK6DJ will be in the Seychelles signing S79/OL1T across the New Year. S7 is not on the air often, so this is a good chance for a new one.

item.title: VU4DX Andaman Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 17 Dec 2026 – 30 Dec 2026] International DXpedition from Port Blair, Andaman Islands, alongside the 49th SEANET Convention. Dates are not yet final; some listings show January 2027.

item.title: 5H1RK Zanzibar, Tanzania 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [23 Dec 2026 – 6 Jan 2027] SP3RK will be on the air from Bwejuu, Zanzibar over the holidays, holiday-style with a vertical. Mostly digital on the higher bands with some CW — a good chance for AF-032.

item.title: ARRL 10-Meter Contest 2026: dates, bands & DXpeditions to work
item.description: [12 Dec 2026 – 13 Dec 2026] From Saturday 12 Dec 0000 UTC to Sunday 13 Dec 2359 UTC, 10 metres only. DX stations send RST plus serial number; with the sun still active, 10m may open well towards the Americas.

item.title: HR5/F2JD Honduras 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [23 Nov 2026 – 15 Mar 2027] Frenchman F2JD is active from Honduras for an extended stay, until mid-March 2027 according to the 425 DX News calendar, including CQ WW CW. QSL via LoTW.

item.title: GS5DXW Scotland 2027: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [1 Jan 2027 – 31 Dec 2027] To mark 20 years of DX-World.net, Col MM0NDX will use the special call GS5DXW throughout 2027. An anniversary call for the site nearly every DXer reads.

item.title: XJ1M Newfoundland, Canada 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [1 Dec 2026 – 31 Dec 2026] VO1 operators will keep the special callsign XJ1M on the air throughout December to mark 125 years since Marconi's first transatlantic reception on 12 December 1901. A special activation is planned on the anniversary day from Signal Hill in St. John's, the site of the historic reception. Confirmations are electronic only.

item.title: VP8THW Falkland Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [12 Dec 2026 – 2 Jan 2027] DL7HW (Herbert) will be on the air as VP8THW from the Falklands from 12 December to 2 January, operating from sites on East and West Falkland, including several first SOTA activations. He will focus on 40 and 20 metres in SSB and FT8, a good evening chance for this South Atlantic entity.

item.title: D44LZ Sal Island, Cape Verde 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [19 Nov 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] Bulgarian operators LZ5VV and LZ1GL are active from Sal Island, Cape Verde, as D44LZ until 2 December. They will also take part in the CQ WW DX CW Contest, so expect a strong signal into Europe on most bands.

item.title: CQ80BH Azores 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [19 Nov 2026 – 25 Nov 2026] Legendary DXer Martti Laine, OH2BH, is celebrating his 80th birthday from the Azores with friends, using the special callsign CQ80BH until 25 November. The Azores are an easy path from Europe, so it is a nice chance for a birthday QSO.

item.title: SV Licence Exams Greece 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 14 Dec 2026 – 16 Dec 2026] Greek regional authorities are announcing the second 2026 exam session for the Class 1 and Entry-level amateur radio licences. In Kastoria, for example, exams take place on 14 and 16 December, with online applications at radioerasitexnes.gov.gr until 4 December. Dates vary by region, so check your own regional announcement.

item.title: T88DT Palau 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Nov 2026 – 3 Dec 2026] JH1OLB will be active from Palau as T88DT, mainly on CW and around the CQ WW DX CW Contest. Morning openings toward the Pacific on the higher bands give European stations the best chance.

item.title: 3B8GY Mauritius 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [3 Dec 2026 – 15 Dec 2026] SP2JMB plans to operate from Mauritius as 3B8GY in early December on 40 to 10 metres, with CW now added. Paths from Europe to the Indian Ocean are usually good at this time of year.

item.title: VP2V/WE9G British Virgin Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [29 Nov 2026 – 9 Dec 2026] WE9G will be on the air from the British Virgin Islands as VP2V/WE9G on CW, SSB and FT8. The activity has been extended to 9 December, leaving plenty of time to log it from Europe.

item.title: 4U1ITU ITU Headquarters, Geneva 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [18 Nov 2026 – 26 Nov 2026] The 4U1ITU station at the International Telecommunication Union headquarters in Geneva is active these days on 160 to 10 metres. It counts as a separate DXCC entity and is an easy contact from most of Europe.

item.title: FR/G3TXF Reunion Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 25 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026] Veteran operator G3TXF will be on CW from Reunion Island, focusing on the WARC bands plus 15 metres. Sources differ on the exact dates, with the main activity expected around 27–29 November.

item.title: 3Y6BUA Antarctica – Troll Station 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: Runar, LA6BUA, will spend about a year at Norway's Troll research station, from November 2026 to December 2027. Expect SSB and digital on wire dipoles for 10/20/40m, with most activity likely from March 2027 onwards. QSL via LoTW only.

item.title: 8Q7XX Maldives 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 16 Nov 2026 – 26 Nov 2026] Andreas, DK6AS, has been active from the Maldives as 8Q7XX since 16 November. He operates mainly CW and FT8/FT4 on 40–10m, perhaps 6m too. His previous trips lasted 7–10 days, so the end date is approximate.

item.title: ZC4MK UK Sovereign Base Areas on Cyprus 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 23 Nov 2026 – 30 Nov 2026] Adrian, G0KOM, is QRV from the UK Sovereign Base Areas on Cyprus as ZC4MK. The start was delayed by generator trouble and activity is expected until around 30 November, including an entry in CQ WW DX CW. From Greece it should be an easy QSO even with a modest station. QSL via G0KOM.

item.title: PZ5KW Suriname 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [23 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] Wian, PE1K, will be on a holiday-style trip to Paramaribo and active as PZ5KW from 23 November to 1 December. Expect mainly FT8 and SSB. QSL via his home call, PE1K.

item.title: ZD7LC St Helena 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [14 Dec 2026 – 1 Jan 2027] More activity from St Helena: ZD7LC is expected on the air from 14 December to 1 January, on SSB and CW across 40–10m. A good second chance for anyone who misses ZD7WP/ZD7VJ. QSL via Club Log OQRS.

item.title: 3B9KW Rodrigues Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 20 Oct 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] M0CFW (JK3GAD) is on Rodrigues Island in the Indian Ocean, signing 3B9/M0CFW until early December. For the CQ WW DX CW contest (Nov 28–29) he will use the contest call 3B9KW, a good chance to log this rare entity.

item.title: TZ4AM Mali 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [22 Oct 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] KX4R is active from Mali as TZ4AM until December 2. He operates CW and SSB on 80–6m, and Mali remains a wanted entity for many European stations.

item.title: V6AIU Micronesia 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [26 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] JH3AIU will be on the air from Weno in the Federated States of Micronesia from Nov 26 to Dec 1, running 300–600 W. The short trip overlaps the CQ WW DX CW weekend, so look for him on CW, FT8 and RTTY.

item.title: PJ7WW / FS Sint Maarten and Saint Martin 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [23 Nov 2026 – 9 Dec 2026] DL1MGB will operate CW only as PJ7WW from Dutch Sint Maarten (Nov 23–30), then from French Saint Martin (FS, Nov 30–Dec 9). Two entities on one island, on 160–10m.

item.title: VP8TAA Falkland Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 26 Nov 2026 – 31 Dec 2026] MW0KZN begins a long stay in the Falkland Islands on November 26, mainly on 40–10m with SSB, FT8 and slow CW. The end date is listed as late December, but the activity may continue until late February.

item.title: FT4YM Antarctica – Concordia Station 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 20 Nov 2026 – 31 Jan 2027] David, F4KFT, is setting up a station at the French-Italian Concordia base on the Antarctic plateau, with first signals expected within days. He stays there until late January and later plans activity from Dumont d'Urville (AN-017) and as /MM from the icebreaker L'Astrolabe; the schedule may change.

item.title: C21GD Nauru 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [10 Dec 2026 – 16 Dec 2026] Shinji, JM1GDA, returns to the tiny Pacific island nation for a week in mid-December. He will be active on 80–6m and will also try contacts via the RS-44 satellite (grid RI39LL).

item.title: K6VHF/HR9 Roatan, Honduras 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Nov 2026 – 5 Dec 2026] Alex, K6VHF, will be on the air from Roatan Island, Honduras for about ten days, including the CQ WW CW weekend. He brings verticals, a hexbeam and a delta loop, so look for him on the low bands too.

item.title: E51A South Cook Islands 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [15 Nov 2026 – 22 Nov 2026] Hrane, YT5A, is already active holiday-style from Rarotonga on CW and FT8 until 22 November. The trip also serves as preparation for a future DXpedition to Manihiki in the North Cook Islands.

item.title: D44JB Santo Antao, Cape Verde 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 14 Nov 2026 – 20 Nov 2026] Charlie, EI8JB, is operating from Santo Antao island with a DX Commander vertical and dipoles, reporting excellent conditions. These are the final days of the activity, planned to end on 20 November; a good chance for 80m FT8 too.

item.title: SX602N Greece – frigate HS Nearchos 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [11 Nov 2026 – 10 Dec 2026] Special call SX602N marks the raising of the Greek flag on the Hellenic Navy's new frigate HS Nearchos (F602), operating from the Votanikos Naval Fort. It is on the air until 10 December on 80–6m and via QO-100; a single valid QSO earns the free electronic HS Nearchos (F602) Award from RAAG.

item.title: TO9W Saint Martin 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [29 Nov 2026 – 11 Dec 2026] A team of eight US operators (K9EL, W9MR, W9AP and others) returns to the French side of St Martin as TO9W. They plan 160–6m on all the main modes, a good chance for a Caribbean contact on the low bands.

item.title: J38W Grenada 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [22 Nov 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] J38W will be active from Grenada in the Caribbean on CW, SSB and digital modes, 160–10m, likely including CQ WW DX CW. The QSL route has not been announced yet.

item.title: OX7AM Greenland 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 23 Nov 2026 – 7 Dec 2026] OX7AM will be on the air from Greenland for about two weeks, including CQ WW DX CW. From Greece the path runs close to the pole, so look for it when 20m and 15m are in good shape.

item.title: ARRL 160-Meter Contest 2026: dates, bands & DXpeditions to work
item.description: [4 Dec 2026 – 6 Dec 2026] From Friday 4 Dec 2200 UTC to Sunday 6 Dec 1559 UTC, CW only on 160m. DX stations work only W/VE (no DX-to-DX), so it is a good test of your 160m antenna across the Atlantic.
